Netanyahu calls PM Modi to discuss West Asia situation and India-Israel relations

Prime Minister Narendra Modi received a telephone call from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Thursday. They discussed the West Asia crisis and bilateral relations between India and Israel. The conversation focused on strengthening ties and cooperation in various sectors. Netanyahu also expressed concerns about regional security and stability. The two leaders agreed to maintain open communication channels.
